# Paper cutout

Layered paper, tactile edges, and a human sense of craft.

## Use

Use for learning stories, workshop invitations, and approachable guides.

## Essential traits

- Layered paper silhouette
- Warm natural palette
- Handcrafted edge detail

## Typography

Georgia serif headings with system sans-serif body.

## Layout and surfaces

Offset paper layers, broad simple shapes, generous margins. Soft paper shadows, slightly uneven borders, earthy cut-paper accents.

## Palette

- background: #f4ecd9
- surface: #fffdf6
- text: #3e4637
- muted: #626b56
- accent: #476b52
- border: #c0c7af

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Paper cutout to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia serif headings with system sans-serif body. Offset paper layers, broad simple shapes, generous margins. Soft paper shadows, slightly uneven borders, earthy cut-paper accents. Palette: background #f4ecd9, surface #fffdf6, text #3e4637, muted #626b56, accent #476b52, border #c0c7af. Essential traits: Layered paper silhouette; Warm natural palette; Handcrafted edge detail. Avoid: Text on busy textures; Excess roughness; Decorations that conceal content. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
